title: Tailwise Grooming Salon Allowance on a Premier Upgrade — Pals Rewards and Tailwise Plus
content:
**Pals Rewards and Tailwise Plus.** On a move up from Tailwise Plus Annual to Tailwise Plus Premier Annual, a Premier salon allowance — a flat dollar amount — is subtracted from the upgrade charge according to the customer's Tailwise Grooming Salon records: whether the customer holds an active grooming pass, and the date of the customer's latest completed grooming visit.

| Active grooming pass | Latest completed visit, counted back from the change date | Premier salon allowance |
|---|---|---|
| held | 60 calendar days or fewer | $10.00 |
| held | more than 60 days, or none | $5.00 |
| not held | any | none |

**Both sides (hypothetical, change on 30 September, active pass held).** Latest completed visit on 1 August (60 days before): $10.00. On 31 July (61 days before): $5.00.
